name: use-multi-view
title: useMultiView
author: Eduardo Retana
description: View, search, filter, sort, group, selection, and open-record state, controlled or uncontrolled, with an optional URL adapter and an optional saved set of enabled views.

meta.descriptionEs: Vista, búsqueda, filtros, orden, grupo, selección y ficha abierta. Controlado o interno, con un adaptador de URL.

examples.title: Adaptador de history
examples.description: La búsqueda y la vista se escriben en la query sin cambiar de ruta.

meta.usage:
const state = useMultiView({ views, url })
const data = useOptimisticRecords({ records, onRecordChange, onCreate, onDelete, onMove })

api.name: url
api.description: get(key) and set(key, value). createHistoryAdapter or useNextMultiViewAdapter.

api.name: viewId / query / filters / sort / groupBy / selectedIds / openId
api.description: Omit them for internal state. groupBy null means no group.

api.name: useOptimisticRecords
api.description: Shows a patch immediately and restores the row if the callback rejects.

api.name: enabledViews / setEnabledViews
api.description: Which views can be selected. Omitting them enables every view. An empty update keeps the previous set, so one view always stays on.

api.name: persistViews
api.description: Reads and writes the enabled set under retana.views.<scope>.<id>. Pass storage in tests.

docs: The state hook does not import Next.js. URL sync for the App Router lives in use-multi-view-url. Changing the view does not clear search or selection. Pair list reordering with use-optimistic-list when you only need order, not a field patch. This hook does not replace filter-toolbar.
